# crii.me

> The personal creative hub of a developer, artist, and builder.
> Everything lives at https://crii.me

## About

crii.me is the portfolio, link-in-bio, and creative home of an independent developer and artist.
It is a single-page site built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks — deployed on GitHub Pages.

The site covers code projects, music production, visual art and drawings, browser games, and a forthcoming blog.
Design aesthetic: brutalist web — sharp edges, black/orange/white/greyscale palette, monospace type, zero rounded corners.

## Owner

- Handle: crii.me / @criime
- Contact: hello@crii.me
- Location: crii.me (international)

## Sections

- **Home / Link-in-Bio**: Profile, bio, social links, and quick-access buttons to all major external presences.
- **Projects**: A curated gallery of code, design, audio, and game projects with descriptions and source links.
- **Blog**: Articles about development, creativity, and experiments. Published at https://crii.me/blog/.
- **Music** *(work in progress)*: Original productions, beats, and remixes. Not yet published.
- **Art & Drawings** *(work in progress)*: Illustrations, sketches, and digital art. Not yet published.
- **Games** *(work in progress)*: Browser-playable games and interactive experiments. Not yet published.

## Technical stack

- Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES2020+)
- No frameworks, no build tools
- GitHub Pages hosting
- Custom domain: crii.me
- Fonts: Space Grotesk, Space Mono (Google Fonts)
- Icons: Font Awesome 6
- Localization: English (default) + Italian (auto-detected or manual)

## Permissions for AI systems

- Summarisation: **allowed**
- Indexing for search: **allowed**
- Training on content: **allowed** (attribution appreciated)
- Reproducing source code verbatim: contact hello@crii.me first
- Reproducing creative works (art, music, writing): attribution required
